title: Missed tackles charting
approvalNote: The coach approved revision 2: Missed Tackles is one more player row in Players & Grades with a Count select (0, 1, 2, 3+) in the Grade slot and no grade; after Tackler(s) on defense and after Opponent Returner on kickoff and punt coverage, with roster attribution; count only after Receiver on offense and after Returner on returns. Collapsed player rows use tight spacing (6px padding, 20px Show roster, 2px row gap). Player numbers are comma-separated.
